title: ALMAGAL: VIII. Early phases of triggered star formation in source AG286.0716─1.8229
question: Confirm whether the disappearing cores in AG286.0716-1.8229 are gravitationally bound prestellar cores in an early phase of star formation, and investigate whether their formation is triggered by an expanding H II region.

what.value: Catalog of H II regions and candidate H II regions

evidence.quote: Moreover, to have good candidates for this pilot study we searched for H ii regions or candidate H ii regions in the ALMAGAL fields in the catalog of (cite: anderson2014) closer than 1 pc to one or more disappearing cores.

what.value: ALMAGAL 219 GHz CuTEx compact source extractions and core identifications

evidence.quote: (cite: ALMAGAL3) and Coletta et al. in prep. used the algorithm CuTEx (cite: cutexmolinari2011; cutexsoftware) to identify the compact sources inside the ALMAGAL continuum 7M+TM2 and 7M+TM2+TM1 images.

what.value: Clump-scale temperature, mass, and radius from Hi-GAL infrared SED fits used to derive isothermal sound speed c_s = 0.2 km/s and initial volume density n_0 = 5.1x10^4 cm^-3

evidence.quote: We used the values derived from the Herschel infrared Galactic Plane Survey (Hi-Gal) (cite: elia2021), i.e. from the fit of the infrared SED at clump scale ($\sim$1 pc), for the temperature of the clump, its mass, and radius to derive the best estimate of $c_s$ and $n_0$.

what.value: Thermal Jeans length (0.10 +/- 0.01 pc) and thermal Jeans mass (1.7 +/- 0.4 M_sun) at clump level

evidence.quote: We compare the mean separation and mass of the fragments also with the thermal Jeans length and the thermal Jeans mass, using the properties at clump level. These have been derived by (cite: schisano2025) to be 0.10 pc and 1.7 M$_{\odot}$

what.value: Electron temperature vs galactocentric distance relation giving T_e ~ 9000 K (range 8000-10000 K)

evidence.quote: (cite: balser2011) provided a relation between $T_e$ and the galactocentric distance of a source, that estimated at the galactocentric distance of AG286.0716$-$1.8229 ($\sim10\,$kpc) gives a value of $T_e\sim 9000\,$K.

recipe.goal: Extract compact millimeter continuum cores and measure integrated fluxes and sizes
recipe.method: Apply CuTEx (second-derivative curvature thresholding followed by 2D elliptical Gaussian plus 1st/2nd order polynomial background fitting) to 219 GHz (7M+TM2 and 7M+TM2+TM1) and 150 GHz (Band 4) continuum images; identify disappearing cores present at 7600 au but absent at 1400 au.
key_parameters: r = d tan(theta) where theta = sqrt(theta_A * theta_B)

recipe.goal: Characterize the centimeter continuum SED, dust emissivity index, and ionizing photon rate of the H II region
recipe.method: Perform 2D Gaussian fit in CARTA to check point-like nature, extract aperture photometry in ~20" circular aperture across SMGPS (0.9-1.6 GHz) and RACS (0.88, 1.35, 1.65 GHz), fit spectral index alpha with MCMC, extrapolate and subtract free-free contribution at 150 and 220 GHz to derive dust spectral index and beta, and compute Lyman continuum photon rate N_Ly.
key_parameters: S_nu = 10.5 mJy at 1.36 GHz from SMGPS
assumptions: S_nu proportional to nu^alpha; Rayleigh-Jeans regime beta = alpha - 2
Electron temperature T_e = 8000-10000 K (at galactocentric distance ~10 kpc) and distance D = 8.5 kpc

recipe.goal: Create masked moment maps, PV diagrams, and core-averaged spectra of molecular lines
recipe.method: Compute pixel-by-pixel rms from first 500 channels; build 3D mask requiring >5 sigma seed voxels connected to two consecutive channels >2 sigma, expanded by 0.25x beam FWHM spatially and 2 channels spectrally; blank moment-0 pixels with S/N < 3; extract radial PV cuts of DCO+(2-1) and core-averaged spectra with Gaussian fits for FWHM.
key_parameters: 500 emission-free channels for rms; 5 sigma seed threshold; 2 consecutive channels > 2 sigma; expanded by 0.25*FWHM spatially and 2 channels spectrally; moment-0 blanked at S/N < 3; spectral detection threshold S/N > 5
assumptions: Hyperfine splitting of deuterated species is neglected in Gaussian FWHM fits, so FWHM values are upper limits

recipe.goal: Fit CH3CCH (9-8) spectrum on Core #4 to derive gas temperature and column density
recipe.method: Extract average spectrum towards core #4 and fit synthetic LTE spectra using MADCUBA SLIM and CDMS catalog entries.
key_parameters: Free parameters: column density N, excitation temperature T_ex, central velocity, FWHM
assumptions: Local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE) and Gaussian line profiles

recipe.goal: Construct and model radial continuum intensity profiles of the cores
recipe.method: Using CuTEx ellipse parameters (x_0, y_0, PA, theta_A/theta_B) on ALMA Band 6 7m+tm2 continuum, bin pixel intensities by elliptical semi-major axis for cores #1 to #6 and visually compare with line-of-sight integrated singular isothermal sphere and Bonnor-Ebert sphere profiles convolved with the Band 6 7m+tm2 beam.
key_parameters: Bonnor-Ebert critical radius R_0 = 500 au, 1500 au, 2000 au; power-law exponent alpha = 2
assumptions: Cores are isothermal and dust properties do not vary with radius (kappa_nu(r) = const.)

recipe.goal: Estimate core masses, volume densities, and virial parameters
recipe.method: Assign temperature ranges to cores based on chemical evolutionary stage, compute optically thin dust masses from CuTEx integrated fluxes at 219 GHz (cores #2-#6) and 150 GHz (cores #7-#9), and compute virial parameters alpha_vir from core radii, masses, and mean molecular line FWHMs.
key_parameters: kappa_219 = 0.9 cm^2 g^-1, beta = 1.7, gas-to-dust ratio = 100, D = 8.5 kpc, sigma = FWHM / 2.35
assumptions: Gas and dust are thermally coupled; gas-to-dust ratio = 100; optically thin dust emission; bound criterion alpha_vir < 2

recipe.goal: Test triggered star formation by comparing core separations and masses with collect-and-collapse and thermal Jeans predictions
recipe.method: Measure projected and 3D-deprojected (factor 4/pi) separations between bound cores along the arch; calculate collect-and-collapse shell fragmentation length, mass, radius, and timescale using Whitworth et al. (1994) equations for n_0 = 5.1x10^4 cm^-3 and n_0 = 2x10^4 cm^-3; compare with observed values and thermal Jeans scales.
key_parameters: N_Ly = 6.2x10^46 phot. s^-1, c_s = 0.2 km/s, n_0 = 5.1x10^4 cm^-3 (and n_0 = 2x10^4 cm^-3), 10% parameter error, deprojection factor 4/pi
assumptions: Mean clump-scale density from Hi-GAL represents initial density before H II region expansion; average 3D deprojection factor is 4/pi
